description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldMultiEnum class, which extends SugarWidgetFieldEnum, providing methods for filtering and querying multi-enum fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. The class includes methods for generating SQL conditions for 'not one of', 'one of', 'is', and 'is not' filters, as well as handling custom multi-enum fields.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldMultiEnum
classes.description: A widget class for handling multi-enum fields, providing filtering and ordering capabilities in reports.

methods.name: queryFilternot_one_of
methods.description: Constructs a SQL condition for filtering records where the multi-enum field does not contain any of the specified values.

methods.name: queryFilterone_of
methods.description: Constructs a SQL condition for filtering records where the multi-enum field contains any of the specified values.

methods.name: queryFilteris
methods.description: Constructs a SQL condition for filtering records where the multi-enum field equals a specific value.

methods.name: queryFilteris_not
methods.description: Constructs a SQL condition for filtering records where the multi-enum field does not equal a specific value.

methods.name: queryOrderBy
methods.description: Provides an order-by clause for multi-enum fields in reports, treating multi-select as a normal field.

methods.name: encodeMultienumCustom
methods.description: Checks if a multi-enum field is custom and escapes it with carets (^) if needed.
